authors.bio: A speculative fiction writer drawn to memory, machinery, and lonely frontiers.

authors.name: Juniper Hale
authors.bio: Creates romantic fantasy with gentle magic and sharp emotional reversals.

authors.name: Rowan Kade

authors.name: Caleb Wynn

authors.name: Soren Bell
authors.bio: Writes historical fantasy with court politics and restrained romance.

authors.name: Wren Ellis
authors.bio: Specializes in contemporary supernatural fiction with dry humor.

authors.name: Ada Laurent
authors.bio: Creates luminous science fantasy about cities drifting between worlds.

authors.name: Theo Grant
authors.bio: Writes action stories with flawed heroes and difficult second chances.

authors.name: Imogen Hart
authors.bio: Explores folklore, grief, and devotion through atmospheric romance.

authors.name: Felix Shore
authors.bio: Writes ensemble adventures set in worlds with unreliable maps.

authors.name: Celeste Armitage
authors.bio: Builds morally complicated thrillers around reputation and hidden identities.

stories.title: The Blood Orchard
stories.synopsis: When disgraced heir Elian Vey returns to the estate that erased his name, every tree in the family orchard whispers the same missing girl's name.

stories.title: The Quiet Machine at Dawn
stories.synopsis: A salvage pilot discovers a silent machine drifting beyond the mapped moons. It remembers her childhood, but its own name has been deleted.

stories.title: A Map for Moonlight
stories.synopsis: A cartographer who can only draw places she has dreamed of is hired by a prince who has never slept.

stories.title: The House Beneath the Stairs
stories.synopsis: Every tenant in Marrow House remembers a different number of floors. June finds a staircase under the kitchen.

stories.title: Snowfall at Room Seven
stories.synopsis: A remote hotel loses power during the first snowstorm. By morning one guest is missing and every room contains a different confession.

stories.title: The Alchemist's Second Life
stories.synopsis: A failed royal chemist wakes in a beginner's body and must build a potion shop in a city that bans unsanctioned miracles.

stories.title: The Saltwind Atlas
stories.synopsis: Three navigators steal an atlas that redraws itself whenever someone tells the truth.

stories.title: The Velvet Treaty
stories.synopsis: To stop a border war, diplomat Sera must marry the heir whose family destroyed her city.

stories.title: The Lanterns of Briar Row
stories.synopsis: A florist inherits a shop whose flowers bloom only for people carrying a secret.

stories.title: Black Signal
stories.synopsis: A crisis negotiator receives a broadcast from a dead operative that predicts scandals one day early.

stories.title: The Last Level Before Dawn
stories.synopsis: A support-class player recruits abandoned teams for a dungeon that resets every sunrise.

stories.title: The Fox in the Rain Court
stories.synopsis: A court musician is promised to a fox spirit who arrives wearing her missing sister's face.

stories.title: The Unreliable Moon
stories.synopsis: The moon above Aster Vale changes shape whenever someone lies.

stories.title: A Knife for Every Name
stories.synopsis: An assassin's cursed blade records every name she refuses to kill, including strangers she has never met.

stories.title: The Detective of Small Miracles
stories.synopsis: A detective who cannot see ghosts can still tell when one has lied. His new partner is a ghost who rearranges evidence.

stories.title: The Crownless Tournament
stories.synopsis: Every champion thinks the tournament winner becomes king. The quietest competitor knows the winner becomes the kingdom's sacrifice.

stories.title: The City That Forgot Its Name
stories.synopsis: A muralist arrives in a city where every street sign is blank and every resident remembers a different history.

stories.title: The River Keeps Score
stories.synopsis: The river around a frontier fortress remembers every soldier it has taken. When it returns one alive, the fortress sends a scout.

stories.title: A Season of Borrowed Stars
stories.synopsis: A stage magician's fake relationship with an astrologer is the only thing keeping a constellation from falling into the city.

stories.title: The Iron Orchard
stories.synopsis: In a kingdom where orchards grow metal, an archivist uncovers a treaty proving the royal family manufactured its enemies.
